why: Take or skip on a circle: the first and last houses cannot both be taken, so the answer is the better of house robber on nums[0..n-2] and on nums[1..n-1].
hints: The only new rule versus a line is that house 0 and house n-1 are neighbours. Can both be taken?
Not both. So either house 0 is excluded or house n-1 is excluded. Each case is an ordinary line of houses.
Run the two-variable house robber on nums[1:] and on nums[:-1] and take the max; with one house return nums[0].
pitfalls: n = 1: both slices are empty, so handle it separately.
Do not just drop the smaller end house; check both cases.
